cloud_receipts: Acknowledgement is persisted on the device; historical receipts are baselined without replay and each future receipt is offered once across reboots.
controlled_parent: Exact published and installed RC31 source tree; RC31 failed practical SIYI Home-marker bench acceptance and is retained only as an exact recovery source.
home_marker: RC32 decodes camera attitude once and projects Home through explicit physical FRD camera axes in NED; fixed and SIYI sources and live/bench Home use one solver.
hotfix_state: No mutable hotfix. RC32 is a new immutable candidate; RC31 is consumed and non-promotable.
operator_workflow: Publish, independently verify, run the exact RC31 read-only preflight, then use FlightCore Software Update.
packaging_correction: Public install.sh is generated only from source public-install.sh and is byte-identical to the archive-tested member; internal install.sh substitution is rejected.
public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC32 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Exact RC31/RC30/RC28/RC26 recovery, accepted RC24, represented historical routes and genuine fresh installation; modified and unknown sources fail closed.
simulation_safety: The 2 km imaginary Home uses the exact live path and is discarded immediately on armed, stale, unknown or disconnected arm state.
